name: Oath of Gideon
oracle_text:
When Oath of Gideon enters, create two 1/1 white Kor Ally creature tokens.
Each planeswalker you control enters with an additional loyalty counter on it.
blocked_sentences: When Oath of Gideon enters, create two 1/1 white Kor Ally creature tokens.
Each planeswalker you control enters with an additional loyalty counter on it.

needs.what: a static replacement on permanents you control matching a filter (types: Planeswalker) that makes them enter the battlefield with N additional counters of a kind (loyalty) beyond those they would normally enter with; it must apply only to the entering event, not to later counter placements
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_counters with counter: loyalty and counter_addend: 1 applies to every loyalty-counter placement, so it would also add one to each +N loyalty activation, which the printed card does not do; enters_tapped is the only enters-with static and it carries no counters
